findings.title: Password grant in use
findings.detail: The client sends the user's password to the token endpoint. OAuth 2.1 removes this grant.
findings.fix: Use the authorization code flow with PKCE for users; keep the password grant to dev scripts.

findings.title: MCP client probed an unsupported protocol version
findings.detail: The server answered 400 to a newer protocol version, and the client fell back. Not an auth failure.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix unless the extra round trip matters; upgrade the server to skip it.

findings.title: Local services are addressed as both localhost and 127.0.0.1
findings.detail: `iss` and `aud` are compared as exact strings, so the same service under two names breaks validation.
findings.fix: Pick one host name per service and use it in config, tokens and redirect URIs.
